name: Mortefi

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T1.5 Tower of Adversity, T2 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 4-star Fusion Pistols Hybrid, the classic F2P-accessible Heavy Attack DMG buffer (Iuno/Augusta/Jiyan/Galbrena teams). Ultimate applies Burning Rhapsody, letting him launch off-field Coordinated 'Marcato' attacks whenever teammates land Basic/Heavy Attacks (2x per Heavy hit). Very fast Concerto rotation.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Impromptu Show (4 hits), Fusion.
skills.resonanceSkill: Passionate Variation - Fusion lightning strike, extends Annoyance gain window.
skills.forte: Fury Fugue - at 100 Annoyance, Skill becomes an AoE Fusion nuke with no cooldown, freely alternated with base Skill.
skills.liberation: Violent Finale - Fusion hit + Burning Rhapsody (Coordinated Marcato attacks on ally Basic/Heavy hits for its duration).
skills.outro: Rage Transposition - 38% Heavy Attack DMG Deepen to next character for 14s or until swap.

bestWeapons: Static Mist (100%, best - CRIT Rate, Energy Regen, ATK boost to next character)
The Last Dance (106.12%, best raw output, Carlotta sig)
echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best - 10% Energy Regen + 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro, with Impermanence Heron)
Empyrean Anthem (better only with endgame-invested Echoes + 5-star weapon)

teams.name: Best Team (Augusta)
teams.notes: Best F2P-accessible Heavy Attack buffer for Augusta.

teams.name: Galbrena Mono Fusion Team
teams.notes: Fast rotation and solid personal damage make him a great Lupa Mono Fusion partner.

teams.name: Alternative Heavy Attack Teams
teams.notes: Usable secondary for Absolution Phoebe and F2P Zani (no Spectro Frazzle application, but functional).

rotation: Intro -> Skill: Passionate Variation -> Skill: Fury Fugue -> Basic 1-4 -> Skill: Fury Fugue -> Ultimate -> Echo (Impermanence Heron swap-cancel). Always cast Ultimate + Outro together right before swapping to the Heavy Attacker.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the top Hybrid characters in endgame for Heavy Attack-centered rotations, thanks to a fast Concerto rotation, strong Outro, and solid off-field Coordinated Attack damage; main drawback is a 20s Ultimate cooldown against only a 10s buff duration requiring careful rotation planning.
